questions.question: How many players are on a cricket team?
questions.explanation: A cricket team has 11 players — and one of them is the wicket-keeper! 🏏

questions.question: How many rings are on the Olympic flag?
questions.explanation: 5 rings represent the 5 continents — blue, yellow, black, green and red! 🏅

questions.question: What sport is played at Wimbledon?
questions.explanation: Wimbledon is the world's oldest tennis tournament, played in London since 1877! 🎾

questions.question: How many points is a try worth in rugby?
questions.explanation: A try scores 5 points in rugby — then you can attempt a conversion for 2 more! 🏉

questions.question: How long is a standard football match?
questions.explanation: Football matches are 90 minutes — 2 halves of 45 minutes each! ⚽

questions.question: Which country has won the most Cricket World Cups?
questions.explanation: Australia has won 6 Cricket World Cup titles — the most of any nation! 🏆

questions.question: In which sport do you score a 'hat-trick'?
questions.explanation: A hat-trick means 3 in a row — 3 wickets in cricket or 3 goals in football! ⚽🏏
